aggregations.measures: fraction of time steps where the pair exceeds the threshold
aggregations.why: Counts how often a relationship holds, ignoring its magnitude.

aggregations.measures: average affinity across time
aggregations.why: General-purpose summary; a strong brief relationship and a weak persistent one can score alike.

aggregations.measures: exponentially decayed affinity, most recent step weighted 1
aggregations.why: Answers what the cohort looks like now rather than on average.

aggregations.measures: population variance of the pair's affinity across time
aggregations.why: High values mark relationships that come and go.

aggregations.measures: OLS slope of affinity against time
aggregations.why: Sign carries the meaning: positive converging, negative diverging.

aggregations.measures: largest single step-to-step jump in affinity
aggregations.why: Isolates abrupt transitions that averages smooth away.
